scientific_integrity: The proof is a symbolic integral Schubert calculus and Poincare duality argument. Standalone exact integer computations for n=2,...,12 check examples but are not a proof for all n.
scientific_limitations: General pencils over the complex numbers, two-plane case only; excludes special pencils, higher isotropic plane dimension, quantum and equivariant cohomology. The annihilator ideal is computationally explicit but no minimal generators are claimed. No independent historical-priority certification.
title: Integral cohomology ring of two-plane odd biisotropic Grassmannians
